A European agri-cooperative (4,200 farms) — Agriculture & Food Systems engagement delivered by a 16-person team over 14 months, EU scope, commercial model: outcome-linked.

items: Field sensing patchy; variable-rate practice guesswork.
Yield/quality discovered at intake; advisory capacity constrained.
Harvest logistics by phone; windows missed.

blocks.x: The field sensor fabric (soil/weather/crop with governance) feeds agronomy models per plot; advisory assistants extend each agronomist to 3x farm coverage; harvest orchestration schedules machines and crews against weather windows; and the agronomy platform unified machine, lab and advisory data per plot.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: Fresh waste down 28%, OOS down 31% — day-part demand and ordering agents
Fault-to-fix down 63% and street-light energy down 22% — urban asset platform

blocks.x: Towers: IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Applied AI & Generative AI, Agentic AI & Hyperautomation. Platforms: BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System, KYC Management System.

items: the decision/data architecture pattern, the control matrix and the run model — adapted per estate in weeks, not quarters.
the baseline numbers and the client's specific regulatory posture — your program starts with its own locked baseline.

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; measurement method available under NDA.
